label: Create table minimal
summary: Creates table minimal with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "minimal" (
  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

postcheck.description: verify table "minimal" has exactly its columns
postcheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('minimal')) = 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('minimal') WHERE (name, LOWER(type), "notnull", pk) IN (VALUES ('createdAt', 'text', 1, 0), ('id', 'text', 1, 1))) = 2
